name: gravedigger19
source:
Caretaker, groundskeeper, grave digger.

My job, an empty pit. 

Occasion turns to routine.

I count the days. Months.

White. Pink. Red. 

October to April. 

War wages on. 

Neutrality is a blessing? 

I try to keep my eyes open. Or closed. 

I can't tell which one these days. 

My care wears thin.

. . .

I reminisce of days content.
